info.title: AssemblyAI Streaming Token API
info.description: API for generating temporary authentication tokens for streaming services

get.description: Generates a temporary authentication token for use with streaming services. See [Authenticate with a temporary token](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/streaming/authenticate-with-a-temporary-token) for more details.

parameters.name: expires_in_seconds
parameters.description: Token redemption window, in seconds. The token must be used to open a WebSocket connection within this window. If the window has elapsed when the WebSocket is opened, the server rejects the session on the first frame. This does NOT cap the duration of the resulting streaming session — once the WebSocket is open the session runs for up to `max_session_duration_seconds`.

parameters.name: max_session_duration_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum duration of the streaming session started with this token, in seconds. If you need to finalize work before the session ends, run a client-side timer using the value you passed here.

x-codeSamples.label: Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
import os

from assemblyai.streaming.v3 import RealTimeTranscriber

client = RealTimeTranscriber(api_key=os.environ["ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"])

token = client.create_temporary_token(expires_in_seconds=60)
print(token)

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript SDK
Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import os

import requests

headers = {"authorization": os.environ["ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"]}

response = requests.get(
    "https://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/token",
    headers=headers,
    params={"expires_in_seconds": 60},
)

response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json()["token"])

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript

expires_in_seconds.description: The token redemption window in seconds — the time the client has to use this token to open a WebSocket before it expires unused. This is not the session duration; see `max_session_duration_seconds` for that.
